Type: frameless rectangular wall mirror
Use: grooming, reflecting light, making a space feel larger; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: plain mirror glass, small metal mounting clips
Colors: silver reflective glass
Shape: plain upright rectangle, flat edgeless glass held by discreet clips at top and bottom, flush to the wall, light and visually weightless
Feel: clean, airy, bright, simple
Goes with: white tiles, white or grey walls, chrome fittings, light wood; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian bathrooms and hallways
